title: Drop the `record` callback argument (move to ambient current-record model)
description: TkVillage window callbacks currently still receive `record`. We intend to remove it so callbacks obtain the current active window record ambiently (rt.g["record"] / village.current_record()), matching Lion's style: contextual state lives in globals, pass only what varies. `rt` has ALREADY been dropped from callback signatures; `record` is still passed for now. Deferring the record drop because it is too involved for the current period and it depends on TkVillage-side work (current-record model, single-active-window invariant, input-port/binding API). Do the TkVillage changes first, then conform Vector Loom. Full considerations, ethos, and sequencing in docs/raw/0002__how-to-drop-record.md.
